item.title: Agent 产品转商
item.summary: Agent 快速商业化的外部共性是：Free/试用降低首次任务摩擦，分层席位授予稳定权益与组织治理，credits/overage 承接高强度使用，真实任务结果和可见预算推动续费与扩张。Claude Code、GitHub、AWS Q、Salesforce 的差异主要来自工作流可验证性、收费单元与用量透明度；公开资料仍不足以证明跨玩家可比的 cohort 续费。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 产品将从模糊 unlimited 权益转向明确额度、可追踪 credits、自动 overage 和团队预算；转商竞争会从模型能力叙事转为 time-to-first-value、weekly retained workflow、renewal/expansion 与有效单位任务成本。
synthesis.strategic_summary: Agent 快速商业化的外部共性是：Free/试用降低首次任务摩擦，分层席位授予稳定权益与组织治理，credits/overage 承接高强度使用，真实任务结果和可见预算推动续费与扩张。Claude Code、GitHub、AWS Q、Salesforce 的差异主要来自工作流可验证性、收费单元与用量透明度；公开资料仍不足以证明跨玩家可比的 cohort 续费。
synthesis.why_now: 头部玩家已从单一 seat 走向 seat＋usage，企业采购同时要求管理员控制、预算上限和结果证明；反证则显示能力提高并不会自动变成生产率或续费。
winner_conditions: 在既有高频工作入口完成首次真实任务
以清晰 Free/Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise 权益承接深度
用 credits、overage、支出上限和告警保证预算可控
将成功任务、人工复核和业务结果写入续费判断
公开 cohort 留存、扩张与有效单位任务成本

evidence.source_quote: We’re making it easier to just build things. Starting today, teams on ChatGPT Business and Enterprise can add Codex-only seats to their workspaces with pay-as-you-go pricing , giving full access to Codex without a fixed seat fee. Now, small groups can begin pilots, prove value in a few critical workflows, and easily expand from there.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Codex 以小团队试点、无固定席位费和 Token 用量计费降低起步门槛，再按使用扩张。

evidence.source_quote: First, we’re doubling Claude Code’s five-hour rate limits for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic 通过提高各付费层的 Claude Code 时段额度维护重度用户体验和套餐价值。

evidence.source_quote: Stack Overflow's 2025 survey reported 84% using or planning to use AI tools, 46% distrusting versus 33% trusting their accuracy, 66% encountering almost-right outputs, 45% reporting extra debugging time, 52% positive about productivity, and a 70% versus 17% gap between personal-time and team-collaboration effects.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 开发者调查显示采用上升但信任不足，说明免费获客和使用不等于续费与组织级价值。

evidence.source_quote: Cursor's community pricing thread records the company adding usage visibility after complaints while users reported opaque limits, surprise charges, trust damage and cancellations; these are community operational signals, not audited company outcomes.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 价格迁移后的额度可见性、意外扣费与沟通争议表明复杂用量计费可能破坏信任和续费。

evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Agentforce 同时提供免费构建、按 action、按 conversation、员工席位和不限量权益，反映多入口转商。

evidence.source_quote: Free Tier: Advanced capabilities at zero cost Pro Tier: Expanded limits $19/mo. per user
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Amazon Q Developer 以永久免费额度获客，以每用户 Pro 订阅换取更高 Agent 请求量和企业控制。

evidence.source_quote: Alibaba reported Cloud external revenue growth of 40%, AI-related product revenue growing triple digits for an eleventh consecutive quarter, AI products accounting for 30% of external Cloud revenue, and annualized AI product revenue of RMB35.8 billion.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 阿里财务披露确认企业 Agent 规模部署和云收入增长，但没有披露具体套餐转化或续费，保留未知边界。

evidence.source_quote: Microsoft reported over 20 million Microsoft 365 Copilot paid seats, paid-seat additions up 250% year over year, customers with over 50,000 seats quadrupling, queries per user up nearly 20% quarter over quarter, first-party Agent monthly active usage up 6X year to date, and nearly 60% of service customers purchasing usage-based credits.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 微软财报的付费席位、大客户扩张和月活增长验证套件分发向企业规模收入迁移。

evidence.source_quote: Anthropic reported $14 billion run-rate revenue, more than 500 customers spending over $1 million annualized versus roughly a dozen two years earlier, Claude Code run-rate revenue over $2.5 billion, weekly active users doubling, business subscriptions quadrupling, and enterprise use representing over half of Claude Code revenue.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Anthropic 官方融资披露高额客户数、企业收入与 Claude Code 运行收入，为转商规模提供方向证据。

evidence.source_quote: Every plan has usage limits that reset on a rolling five-hour session window, and paid plans add weekly limits on top. Your activity across Claude on web, desktop, mobile, and Claude Code all draws from the same pool. How much you can do depends on the length and complexity of your conversations, the model you choose, and the features you use, so there's no fixed message count. Free covers everyday questions. Pro gives you at least 5x more usage per 5-hour session than Free. Max gives you 5x or 20x more usage per 5-hour session than Pro. On Team plans, Standard seats give more than Pro and Premium seats give 5x more than Standard. To manage capacity and make sure all users have fair access, we may limit your usage in other ways, such as weekly and monthly caps or model and feature usage, at our discretion. When you reach a limit, you can wait for it to reset, move to a higher plan, or, on paid plans, turn on usage credits to keep working at standard API rates. You can see where you stand anytime in Settings > Usage .
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Claude 以免费层、Pro、Max、团队与用量 credits 构成分层权益和超额使用路径。

evidence.source_quote: Usage credits allow individuals subscribed to paid Claude plans (Pro, Max 5x, and Max 20x) to continue using Claude seamlessly after reaching their included usage limits. Instead of being blocked when you hit your session limits, you can switch to consumption-based pricing at standard API rates and continue your work without interruption.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Claude 在订阅额度耗尽后切换按 API 价格付费，把重度使用从封顶套餐引导至增量消费。

evidence.source_quote: Team and Enterprise plan admins can now upgrade to premium seats with Claude Code—and take advantage of flexible pricing with extra usage options. Both Team and Enterprise plans include granular spend caps, self-serve seat management, and Claude Code usage analytics.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Claude 企业套餐用标准/高阶席位、额外用量和预算分析完成席位到消费的混合计费。

evidence.source_quote: GitHub Copilot Max is built for heavy Copilot usage, including sustained agent-driven workflows, and includes $100/month in GitHub AI Credits.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: GitHub Copilot 用免费层、三档个人订阅、内含 credits 与可购买额外用量完成清晰的强度分层。

evidence.source_quote: METR reported that its early-2025 randomized study found experienced open-source developers took 19% longer with AI tools (95% CI +2% to +39%); later 2026 data suggested speedup but the organization warned that severe selection effects make the magnitude unreliable.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: 随机试验在早期工具与资深开源开发者场景发现减速，后续样本又受选择偏差影响；这限制了从主观提效或使用强度直接推导续费价值。

evidence.source_quote: OpenAI's Zenken customer story reported over 90% weekly active usage, about 900 messages per person per month, 30–50% time savings, JPY50 million annual outsourcing savings, 15–20% higher initial proposal approval and 30% higher final approvals.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Zenken 的周活、节省时间和外包成本展示企业席位续费与扩张应由可量化业务价值支撑。
